title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E4 — Botulism
An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E5 — Cook's Tour
DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E17 — Waiting for Insane Wayne
The team pretends to be mercenaries to protect a teenage squatter (Moosie Drier) from an unscrupulous landowner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E18 — The Duke of Whispering Pines
B.A.'s old girlfriend (Sheila DeWindt) calls on him to find her investor husband, B.A.'s former school rival.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E19 — Beneath the Surface
The team helps Face's old high-school buddy (Tom Villard) locate a sunken Spanish galleon filled with treasure.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E20 — Mission of Peace
The team outmaneuvers swindlers plotting to evict a group of enterprising senior citizens; guest Jason Evers.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E21 — The Trouble With Harry
A mobster, avenging his brother's death, stalks an alcoholic ex-boxer; guests Hulk Hogan, William "The Refrigerator" Perry.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E22 — A Little Town With an Accent
A crafty mobster (Mark Lawrence) fakes his own death to avoid prison and plots to take over a town.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E23 — The Sound of Thunder
The search for the half-Vietnamese daughter (Tia Carrere) of Gen. Fulbright leads the team to a resourceful teenager bent on vengeance.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E1 — Dishpan Man
Gen. Stockwell (Robert Vaughn) blackmails the team into rescuing hostages held on board a Mexican airliner by terrorists.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E2 — Trial by Fire
The team faces court-martial in the murder of a colonel who was cooperating with the enemy; guest David Ackroyd.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E4 — Ricky
At a New Mexico track, Banner helps a race driver's mentally impaired brother; guest Gerald McRaney.
